findings.issue: PR gate takes moving inputs: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master, checkout@v5 / setup-python@v6 / cache@v5 mutable tags, pip install maturin>=1.8,<2 floating, ubuntu-latest and python 3.11 float; sc-compose transitive deps unlocked. Same commit can pass one day and fail the next.
findings.recommendation: Pin actions to full commit SHAs; pin maturin exactly; use ubuntu-24.04; dtolnay/rust-toolchain@<sha> with toolchain 1.94.1 or rustup against rust-toolchain.toml. No retries.
findings.evidence: uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master; pip install "maturin>=1.8,<2"; runs-on: ubuntu-latest

findings.issue: Default wheel dir is fixed ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/sc-agent-wheels and the script rm -rf's it; two concurrent local runs delete each other's wheel. Existing .sc-publish-kit reused without reset/clean.
findings.recommendation: Default wheel dir to mktemp -d with trap cleanup or under target/; git reset --hard && clean -fdx the kit checkout after pin checkout.

findings.issue: git clone/fetch, pip install, cargo publish --dry-run have no per-step deadline; CI 45-min timeout is the only bound and fails without naming the step; local runs unbounded.
findings.recommendation: Wrap network steps in timeout with per-step message; set pip --timeout, CARGO_HTTP_TIMEOUT, CARGO_NET_RETRY; per-step timeout-minutes in workflow. No retry loops.
findings.evidence: git clone --quiet --depth 1 ...; git fetch --quiet origin "$kit_revision" --depth 1; cargo publish --dry-run --locked
